title: A method for attacking global data distribution in federated learning scenarios

pse.problem: The security of shared gradients in federated learning is insufficient, allowing attackers to recover private training data of each client through leaked shared gradient.
pse.solution_function: Adapts deep reinforcement learning algorithm (DDPG) to adjust the distribution of malicious client local data under the supervision and guidance of shared gradients, eventually inferring the distribution of global data in federated learning.
pse.solution_structure: Includes various parameters, environments, tools required for attack preparation; utilizes DDPG as part of the overall attack process.
pse.solution_implementation: Pre-attack preparation involves setting up necessary parameters and resources. The main attack process involves adjusting the distribution of malicious client local data through DDPG under the supervision and guidance of shared gradients.
pse.effect: Potentially allows an attacker to recover sensitive global data in federated learning scenarios
